preferences: Prefer concrete UI examples using IDs, classes, and before/after behavior.
Prefer small reversible improvements with visible browser verification.
Keep unsafe text editing and other weakly proven features deferred.
Persist important process and evidence in the relevant project documentation.
Use white/light HTML reports for internal status review.
Prefer functional factories, SSOT, destructured options, and modular ownership.

recommendedPromptShape.roundGoal: One sentence describing the desired outcome.
recommendedPromptShape.mustFix: Numbered acceptance behaviors that must pass.
recommendedPromptShape.deferred: Explicitly postponed features and the proof required to reopen them.
recommendedPromptShape.evidence: Expected tests, browser viewport, and saved artifact locations.
recommendedPromptShape.releaseImpact: Whether the round changes the customer version or only internal tooling.
